notes: Single-family house, Sears Plat Lot 1. Truth transcribed from four sheets read as rendered images (the CAD text layer interleaves note columns): S-0.0 General Structural Notes (concrete strengths, sheathing specs, anchor bolts, hold-down schedule, joist hangers), A3 Foundation Plan (footing schedule, slab/crawlspace notes), A4 Main Floor Framing Plan, A8 Roof Framing Plan. Sheets A5/A6/A7 (floor plans, upper framing), A9-A12 (elevations/sections), E1-E2 (electrical) and C4.01/C8.0 (civil) were NOT enumerated, so this is partial. Only one quantity is stated anywhere on the sheets read (the 1,974 SF crawlspace vapor retarder); every other quantity is left null rather than derived, because a derived takeoff would be a guess dressed as truth. This is a single house with no repeated units — the extraction's REPEATED UNITS rule must NOT scale anything here.
